original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Interpol issued a red alert requesting the location and arrest of 39-year-old Anastasiia Berezovska

The woman suspected of carrying out a parcel bombing in Monaco which injured a sanctioned Ukrainian multi-millionaire and his family has been found dead, Ukraine's security service (SBU) has said.

A cross-border manhunt had been launched for Anastasiia Berezovska, a Ukrainian woman who officials believed had fled the wealthy city-state after planting the bomb in the entrance hall of an apartment building on 29 June.

The 39-year-old's body was found with gunshot wounds to the head, according to the SBU.

Two people including a current officer within Ukraine's Ministry of Defence (MoD) have been detained on suspicion of murder.

Berezovska arrived in Ukraine two days after the attack on 1 July, the SBU said in its statement, citing law enforcement sources.

There, she communicated with her family and two men - a former law enforcement officer and a current officer in the MoD's main intelligence directorate.

The two men were investigated as possible accomplices in the Monaco attack based on information that they "repeatedly transferred funds" to Berezovska's "crypto and bank accounts".

The intelligence officer subsequently confessed to Berezovska's murder and said he had done so with "another suspect", the agency said.

It continued: "During the search of the former law enforcement officer's home, a basement room resembling a torture chamber was found.

"Both suspects were detained on suspicion of committing murder with premeditation by a group of individuals."

Ukrainian suspect hunted by police after Monaco bomb attack was 'disguised as a man'

Monaco's deputy prosecutor Morgan Raymond said Berezovska had spent days casing out the residence and was "disguised as a man" during the attack last Monday.

Three people were injured, two of them seriously, when a package exploded just as they entered the building shortly after 21:00 local time (19:00 GMT).

Berezovska was believed to have fled in a hire car to Italy and onwards to Germany - where special forces searched an apartment rented by a 39-year-old Ukrainian woman "currently on the run" in the central state of Hesse on Thursday, police said.

Interpol issued a red notice alerting police worldwide that she was a fugitive wanted for attempted murder, placing an explosive device on a public road with criminal intent and criminal conspiracy on Friday.

[Lähde: The Mirror]
A woman suspected of attempting to murder a Ukrainian oligarch in Monaco has reportedly been found dead.

Vadim Ermolaev, 58, was seriously injured in an explosion outside his property last month and images were released of a person authorities were seeking in connection with the incident.

Interpol identified Anastasiia Berezovska, a 39-year-old Ukrainian woman, as the suspect behind the attack in Monaco on June 30, which left Ermolaev, his partner and his son in hospital.

It was initially thought that the suspect was a man, but later police revealed they believe this was a disguise. An arrest warrant was issued for Berezovska, who is suspected of fleeing the scene on foot and then driving to Germany.

An Interpol Red Notice issued on Friday said Berezovska was wanted in Monaco for attempted murder, placing an explosive device in a public place with criminal intent and criminal conspiracy.

It said she was born in Ukraine, speaks German and last resided in Germany. The notice described her as having dark hair and a tattoo, possibly of a snake, on her right arm from the shoulder to the elbow.

And in a dramatic update, she has reportedly now been found shot dead near Kyiv.

According to Ukrainian site Pravda, citing sources, two suspects have been detained over her death. One of them is a current officer of the Main Intelligence Directorate (GUR) of the Ministry of Defense, and the other is a former law enforcement officer.

A law enforcement source close to the investigation in Monaco described the suspect as "armed" and "dangerous".

German police said on Friday that they had searched the rented flat and car of a 39-year-old Ukrainian woman. "Evidence was secured which will be handed over to Monaco authorities," they said, adding: "The wanted woman is currently on the run."

Meanwhile, Monaco deputy prosecutor Morgan Raymond said the "relative sophistication of the explosive device and the modus operandi seem to indicate that the person who planted the explosive device did not act alone". He said two men were arrested in Monaco earlier this week but were later released after investigators found no evidence linking them to the attack.

The parcel bomb exploded at the entrance of the apartment block on Rue Révérend Père Louis Frolla at around 9pm local time.

payload.title: Monacon paketti-iskusta epäilty nainen löytyi kuolleena Ukrainasta
payload.summary: Monacon pakettiräjähdyksestä epäilty Anastasiia Berezovska on löydetty kuolleena Ukrainasta. Iskussa haavoittuivat ukrainalainen liikemies Vadim Ermolaev, hänen kumppaninsa ja hänen poikansa.
payload.content:
Monacossa ukrainalaiseen liikemieheen Vadim Ermolaeviin ja hänen perheeseensä kohdistuneesta pakettiräjähdyksestä epäilty Anastasiia Berezovska on löydetty kuolleena Ukrainasta, Ukrainan turvallisuuspalvelu SBU kertoo. Viranomaisten mukaan 39-vuotiaan ukrainalaisnaisen ruumiissa oli ampumahaavoja päässä, ja kaksi ihmistä on otettu kiinni murhasta epäiltyinä.

## Epäiltyä etsittiin useassa maassa

Berezovskasta oli käynnistetty kansainvälinen etsintä sen jälkeen, kun räjähde oli viranomaisten mukaan asetettu kerrostalon sisääntuloaulaan Monacossa. Iskussa haavoittui kolme ihmistä, joista kaksi vakavasti. Uhrien joukossa olivat 58-vuotias ukrainalainen liikemies Vadim Ermolaev, hänen kumppaninsa ja hänen poikansa.

Monacon apulaissyyttäjä Morgan Raymondin mukaan Berezovska oli tarkkaillut asuinpaikkaa useiden päivien ajan ennen iskua. Viranomaisten mukaan hänen uskottiin olleen mieheksi naamioituneena hyökkäyksen aikana. Aluksi etsittyä henkilöä pidettiin miehenä, mutta poliisi kertoi myöhemmin uskovansa kyseessä olleen naamio.

Räjähdys tapahtui hieman sen jälkeen, kun uhrit olivat saapumassa rakennukseen kello 21:n jälkeen paikallista aikaa. Berezovskan epäiltiin paenneen paikalta jalan ja jatkaneen sen jälkeen vuokra-autolla ensin Italiaan ja edelleen Saksaan. Saksassa erikoisjoukot etsivät myöhemmin asuntoa Hessenin osavaltiossa. Poliisin mukaan asunto oli vuokrattu 39-vuotiaalle ukrainalaisnaiselle, jonka kerrottiin olleen tuolloin paossa.

## Kaksi kiinniottoa Ukrainassa

Interpol julkaisi Berezovskasta kansainvälisen etsintäkuulutuksen, jossa poliiseja eri maissa kehotettiin paikantamaan ja pidättämään hänet. Häntä etsittiin epäiltynä muun muassa murhan yrityksestä, räjähteen asettamisesta julkiselle paikalle rikollisessa tarkoituksessa ja rikollisesta salaliitosta.

Ukrainan turvallisuuspalvelun mukaan Berezovska saapui Ukrainaan 1. heinäkuuta eli kaksi päivää Monacon iskun jälkeen. SBU:n mukaan kaksi henkilöä on pidätetty epäiltyinä hänen murhastaan. Heistä toinen on nykyinen Ukrainan puolustusministeriön upseeri.

Tapaus liittyy usean maan viranomaistoimiin. Monacossa tutkitaan räjähdeiskua, Saksassa selvitettiin epäillyn mahdollista pakoreittiä, ja Ukrainassa Berezovskan kuolemaa käsitellään henkirikosepäilynä.
